skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Amidst the Pieces
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Amidst the Pieces. Puzzle knows that he should tailor his attire to his target—one of the most efficient ways to win trust and exchange intel. When alone, however, he barely spares a thought to his appearance.
skins.quote: 'These tweezers? I use them to pick up puzzle pieces. The ones too small or too thin are rather difficult to grasp with your fingers. They have no other use apart from this.'

skins.name: Cool Colored Rock 'n' roll
skins.content: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Cool Colored Rock 'n' roll. Puzzle quickly mastered the instrument in his hand, completing his transformation to an idol with nary a hitch. Now, his mission truly begins.
skins.quote: A conspicuous new identity is not necessarily a bad thing for him. When people start to let their guards down thanks to his soothing melody, the cool-colored network woven by him is already quietly spreading.
